headlines.summary: 시황 악화 등 반영 내년 7월로 유예 상폐돼도 요건 충족땐 ‘코넥스’ 이전 코스피가 107.73포인트(1.64%) 오른 6687.21에 장을 마감 마감한 4일 오후 서울 중구 하나은행 본점에서 딜러들이 업무를 보고 있다. 코스닥은 23.29포인트(2.95%) 오른 813.50에 마감, 원·달러 환율은 8.9원 내린 1350.4원에 마감했다. 2026.09.

headlines.summary: 정부, 상장사 반발에 '속도조절' 시총기준 상향 내년 7월로 연기 정부가 부실기업 퇴출을 위해 코스닥 상장폐지 시가총액 기준을 높이려던 계획을 6개월 유예하기로 했다. 이에 따라 내년 1월이 아니라 7월부터 제도가 시행된다. 또 상장폐지에 따른 충격을 줄이기 위해 일정한 재무 요건을 충족한 기업은 정리매매 없이 코넥스 이전 상장을 허용한다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea and US Formalize Semiconductor Investment Discussions
key_headlines.summary: The Blue House confirmed that semiconductor investment is part of official Korea-US negotiations, with the US emphasizing investment is necessary to avoid tariffs. The government plans to announce the first US-directed investment project soon.

key_headlines.title: KOSDAQ Delisting Standards Postponed by Six Months to July 2027
key_headlines.summary: The government delayed its plan to strengthen market capitalization criteria for KOSDAQ delistings by six months due to market deterioration. Profitable companies will be allowed to transfer to KONEX without liquidation trading.

key_headlines.title: Unregistered Stock Trading via Security Tokens Begins February 2027
key_headlines.summary: Starting February 2027, unregistered stocks and institutional bonds will be tradable as security tokens (STOs), with expansion planned to include listed stocks, bonds, real estate, and artwork in the medium term.

key_headlines.title: Government Establishes National Economic-Fiscal Education Institute
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance plans to establish a dedicated National Economic-Fiscal Education Institute to strengthen public economic education and systematize job training, including convergence education linked to cross-departmental policies.

key_headlines.title: AI Data Center Cooling Solutions Create New Market for Oil Refiners
key_headlines.summary: Oil refineries are entering the immersion cooling fluid market as AI data centers face increased heat challenges. Liquid immersion cooling offers better efficiency than traditional air cooling while reducing power consumption from 30-40% to lower levels.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic landscape shows mixed signals with semiconductor exports surging 68.7% year-over-year in August, yet consumer sentiment remains disconnected from growth statistics. Youth employment continues to decline for the 45th consecutive month, with unemployment hitting a five-and-a-half-year high despite government intervention efforts. The government is implementing structural reforms including delaying KOSDAQ delisting criteria and introducing security token trading to modernize financial markets and attract investment.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's Q2 real GDP growth rate decelerated to 0.6% from 1.8% in Q1, reflecting slowing economic momentum despite strong semiconductor performance. The Bank of Korea raised its 2026 growth forecast to 3.3%, yet a persistent gap exists between macro statistics and consumer sentiment. National debt excluding operational deficits is projected to exceed 1,300 trillion won by 2029, though the debt-to-GDP ratio is expected to improve from 50.6% this year to 48.3% next year due to semiconductor-driven tax revenue growth.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI closed at 6,687.21 points (up 1.64%) while KOSDAQ gained 2.95% to 813.50, with the Korean won strengthening 8.9 won against the dollar to 1,350.4. Market sentiment remains heavily dependent on US interest rate direction, with investors watching for signals from Federal Reserve policy and US Treasury yields around the 5% level. Foreign and institutional investors returned to Korean markets after a six-day absence as concerns about rate hikes eased following dovish comments from Fed officials.
sections.Industry & Technology: Currency fluctuations are creating divergent sector performance, with airlines and steelmakers strengthening while automakers and shipbuilders weaken as the won appreciates. Oil refineries are competing in the emerging immersion cooling fluid market for AI data centers, addressing heat dissipation challenges that current air-cooling systems cannot efficiently handle. GS Engineering and LGU+ are collaborating to develop standardized modular AI data center models to accelerate construction timelines and meet surging demand.
sections.Real Estate: Korea's rental market is experiencing structural transformation as lease (jeonse) contracts decline while monthly rents (wolse) increase, attracting foreign institutional investors. The government is considering tax relief for corporate rental businesses to shift the private rental market from individual landlords to institutional operators, addressing housing supply shortages. Real estate investment regulations, particularly regarding timing of purchase and sale for redevelopment projects, significantly affect tax obligations.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve faces pressure between strong employment data arguing for rate increases and political pressure from President Trump demanding rate cuts ahead of the September 15-16 FOMC meeting. Trump has expanded trade tensions beyond tariffs to currency issues, questioning the US-Canada dollar exchange rate as market fundamentals suggest rate increases remain probable. Emerging market economies like those in Latin America are considering tightening policies amid growing global inflation concerns.
sections.AI & Economy: AI data centers are driving innovation in industrial cooling technology, with immersion cooling offering energy efficiency improvements over traditional air-cooling methods that consume 30-40% of power. GS Engineering is developing standardized prefabricated modular data centers to reduce construction time and meet accelerating AI infrastructure demand across Asia. Korea is positioning itself as a hub for AI development, with forums and initiatives promoting AI integration into traditional manufacturing and regional economies.
sections.Others: Paradoxically, AI is displacing high-skilled workers in developing economies, with educated Kenyans losing assignment-writing jobs to AI systems despite 25% youth unemployment. Ukraine's parliament is considering legalizing adult content to generate war funding, reflecting creative but controversial approaches to financing national needs. Tourism destinations like Turkey face reduced visitor appeal as currency depreciation fails to offset domestic inflation, making former budget-friendly destinations increasingly expensive for foreign tourists.
